h: Don Jazzy announces tech scholarship for Nigerians and plans to provide laptops
p: Mavin Records boss Don Jazzy has reportedly announced a scholarship for Nigerians who want to study technology, and says he plans to provide laptops for beneficiaries. Fans are praising the move online.
more: Details on how to apply are said to be coming soon.
The announcement follows other donations he has reportedly made recently.
